brief: Calculate how much a recipient receives after a remittance fee and a stated exchange rate.

title.pt-BR: O que chega após o câmbio?

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Exchange Proceeds"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Qué llega tras el cambio?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O que chega após o câmbio?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Calculate how much a recipient receives after a remittance fee and a stated exchange rate.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A transfer fee and exchange rate both affect what arrives; follow a fictional quote with its fee order stated.
instruction.misconception: The full send budget converts even when a fee is deducted first, or exchange-rate direction can be reversed freely.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: When the quote deducts a sending fee first, subtract it before multiplying by recipient units per sending unit.
Only the post-fee amount is converted.
The quote defines the order of deduction and conversion.
Convert the budget remaining after the sending fee.
The units determine which operation produces the recipient amount.
A recipient-side deduction reduces the converted amount.
The receiving amount reflects both the fee and conversion.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A transfer fee and exchange rate both affect what arrives; follow a fictional quote with its fee order stated.

en-US.prompt: Fictional sending budget 100; fee 5 deducted first; each sending unit buys 2 recipient units. No other fees.

feedback.met: Only the post-fee amount is converted.

help: Resta comisión de envío antes de aplicar tipo indicado.
